content.short: Pulse Domains provides pulseChain's naming service, turning wallet addresses into memorable names.
content.description: Pulse Domains turns 45-character wallet addresses into easy-to-remember names, such as katieepcrypto.pls, making addresses more human-friendly and shareable. It also offers pls.fyi profiles that function as decentralized alternatives to Linktree, enabling connections and link sharing without centralized hosting. Domains can be resolved through their .pls names, or via the pls.to feature to access IPFS-hosted sites, providing flexible options for identity and content addressing in crypto ecosystems.
